title: A space for human encounter
concept: CONFLUYE is a space for human encounter where people, their emotions, relationships and experiences become the starting point for building individual and collective well-being.
description: CONFLUYE is a social enterprise that promotes the comprehensive well-being of individuals and groups through consulting, support, training and specialized intervention services in the field of human, emotional and social well-being.

The enterprise starts from a central premise: well-being is not only an individual experience; it is also built, expressed and transformed within relationships, groups, organizations and communities. Emotions, perceptions, bonds, conflicts, feelings of belonging and shared experiences can take on a collective dimension and influence the way people live together, work, learn, participate and shape their surroundings.

From this perspective, the enterprise brings together contributions from different fields of knowledge related to well-being, the social sciences, psychology, education, people management and the study of emotions and collective dynamics. Its purpose is to translate this knowledge into practical solutions adapted to the needs of different audiences and contexts.

The proposal aims to develop a versatile range of services that makes it possible to intervene at different stages of life and in different social spaces: children, adolescents, young people, adults, families, educational institutions, organizations, work teams, communities and other social groups.

The intervention model may combine assessment, consulting, training, workshops, development programs, support and the design of well-being strategies, according to the characteristics and needs of each group.
purpose: To contribute to building healthier, more cohesive and more humane societies by developing the well-being of individuals and groups, creating spaces that foster personal growth, healthy relationships, coexistence, participation, a sense of belonging and the ability to face social and everyday challenges.
